This preserves flexibility for any potential revisions agreed upon later, addresses my concerns somewhat proportionally, acknowledges the employer's commitment despite the gap, and avoids unnecessary complications related to unproven external competition.

So yes, I’ll accept the offer, staying mindful though to seek clarity on the remaining discrepancies and possibly request additional information on valuation projections or specific equity parameters to facilitate further negotiations downstream.
